page.layout: One page of running text, with two marginal notes in the right margin, beside the canons. No other blocks.

main_text.p: Turcæ denuò in Asia Mi-(3.) in-staura-tio.nore regnarunt.
Cùm tempestas ista Tartarica i-terum dissipata fuisset, Turcæ colle-cti denuò in Asia Minore potestatem suam instaurarunt A. C. 1200[?].

Conditor ejus fuit Osman, unde etiam hodierna familia Imperatorum Turcicorum vocatur Osmanni-dorum, ipsorumq; Sedes Porta Osman-nica. Hic Osman A. C. 1300. fa-ctus Rex Turcarum brevi tempore maximum Imperium posteris suis reliqvit, ita, ut tertius ab illo Morad sive Amurad in ipsam Europam pe-netra-

page.notes: Right margin notes read "(3.) in-" / "staura-" / "tio." and "(4) Au-" / "ctio.", set beside the canons. The date after "A. C." is read as 1200 but the last digits are unclear, so it is marked [?]. "Canon 4" is read from the marginal numbering (4) and the form of the numeral, so it is marked [?]. The left edge shows show-through and a page edge, which are left out. The paragraph ends on "netra-" and continues on the next page.
